product: Account-only user access to Genie One is generally available
tagline: Account only user access to account level Genie One is now generally available.
what_it_does: Account only user access to account level Genie One is now generally available. Users provisioned through automatic identity management or account level System for Cross domain Identity Management (SCIM) can use Genie One without being assigned to a workspace or granted a workspace entitlement. Unity Catalog privileges govern the data and assets that each user can access.
why_it_matters: Unity Catalog privileges govern the data and assets that each user can access.
